Finastra.evidence: Finastra is an active corporate entity registered in the UK (Companies House) and maintains its official website at finastra.com. The company actively provides the 'Finastra Trade Innovation' platform and announced digital trade finance partnerships as recently as September 2026 (Finastra Press Release / Website).

UAE Trade Connect LLC.evidence: UAE Trade Connect (UTC) was launched in 2021 by e& enterprise and a consortium of UAE banks to manage trade finance risks and prevent fraud using blockchain technology. In March 2024, the company officially rebranded as Haifin and operates via the website haifin.com to support its international expansion across the trade finance market.
